jobs.title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Claude)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with Client teams to design, build, and ship production AI solutions on Anthropic's Claude platform. This is an individual contributor role. You will write the code, build the agents and integrations, connect Claude to Client data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

You will work inside a Collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. You will partner directly with Client business and IT stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working Claude solution, then harden it for production on the Microsoft data stack and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

Claude Solution Development

Build agents, assistants, and knowledge search experiences using the Claude API, including tool use, extended thinking, structured outputs, prompt caching, and batch processing
Build agentic workflows with the Claude Agent SDK, including multi-step orchestration, subagents, and human-in-the-loop controls
Build and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect Claude to Client systems such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SharePoint, CRM, and ERP platforms
Deploy Claude through the Anthropic API, Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI based on Client requirements
Write and iterate on system prompts, tool definitions, and Agent Skills based on test results and user feedback

Claude for Enterprise and Claude Code

Configure and roll out Claude for Enterprise, including connectors, Projects, Skills, and admin controls
Use Claude Code to accelerate delivery, and help Client engineering teams adopt it with sound workflows, permissions, and guardrails
Build reusable Skills, plugins, and prompt libraries that encode Client processes and standards

Retrieval and Data Foundations

Build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding
Partner with Collectiv data engineers to connect Claude solutions to Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms
Integrate Claude solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, Azure Functions, and event-driven architectures

Evaluation and Production Readiness

Build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
Implement logging, monitoring, tracing, and cost controls for deployed agents
Apply security, identity, and data governance controls appropriate to each Client environment
Use version control, CI/CD, and code review standards for all AI solution code and configuration

Consulting and Collaboration

Work directly with Client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
Translate business problems into scoped, buildable AI use cases with clear success metrics
Train Client users and engineers on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
Contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to Collectiv's AI practice

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or analytics engineering
1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI or LLM-powered solutions in production or Client environments
Hands-on experience with the Claude API, including tool use
Experience building or deploying MCP servers
Hands-on experience with Claude Code or the Claude Agent SDK
Strong Python or TypeScript skills
Experience building RAG solutions, including vector search and document ingestion
Experience working in at least one major cloud (Azure preferred, AWS or Google Cloud also valued)
Ability to work independently in a Client-facing consulting role

Preferred Qualifications

Experience deploying Claude through Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI
Experience rolling out Claude for Enterprise or Claude for Work to business users
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Power BI
Experience with LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for AI in regulated industries
Consulting experience across multiple Clients or industries
Anthropic training or certifications, or relevant Azure certifications

What Success Looks Like In This Role

Claude solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed
Clients trust you as the engineer who knows how to make Claude work in their environment
Your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff
You contribute MCP servers, Skills, and accelerators that make Collectiv's next Claude engagement faster

Why Collectiv

Join Collectiv for a rewarding career in a fully remote work environment with quarterly in-person team Experiences and competitive compensation. We provide a clear growth trajectory with professional development opportunities and a top-shelf benefits package. Enjoy unlimited time off and 100% covered health insurance, encompassing medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. Our comprehensive offerings, from a competitive 401(k) with a 4% match to educational assistance, tech stipend, and discounts on various goods and services, demonstrate our commitment to your well-being and success.

Collectiv is the leading boutique consulting and strategy firm specializing in Analytics, Planning, and AI with Power BI and the Microsoft data stack.

Our mission at Collectiv is simple: We help enterprises break free from stagnation and make better decisions.

Our Core Values

Growth Mindset: Bring solutions, not problems.
Excel with Humility: Be humbly brilliant.
Communicate Actively and Empathetically: Listen, ask, understand, help.
Work Hard, Play Hard: Results are proportional to effort.
Keep Calm and Carry On: Stay cool, calm, and Collectiv.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with Client teams to design, build, and ship production AI solutions on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry (now Microsoft Foundry). This is an individual contributor role. You will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

You will work inside a Collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. You will partner directly with Client business and IT stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working AI solution, then harden it for production.

Key Responsibilities

Copilot Solutions

Build declarative agents, Copilot connectors, and plugins that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with Client data and workflows
Build Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes
Connect Copilot to SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, and line-of-business systems
Write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback

Azure AI Foundry Solutions

Build custom agents and AI applications in Azure AI Foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box Copilot
Select, deploy, and configure models from the Foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency
Implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, Azure Functions, Power Automate, and Logic Apps

Retrieval and Data Foundations

Build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding
Use Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence to index and extract knowledge from Client content
Partner with Collectiv data engineers to connect AI solutions to Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms

Evaluation and Production Readiness

Build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models
Apply security, identity, and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI Content Safety
Use version control, CI/CD, and code review standards for all AI solution code and configuration

Consulting and Collaboration

Work directly with Client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
Translate business problems into scoped, buildable AI use cases with clear success metrics
Train Client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
Contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to Collectiv's AI practice

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or Microsoft 365 and Power Platform development
1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI or LLM-powered solutions in production or Client environments
Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and Copilot Studio
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI
Experience building RAG solutions with Azure AI Search
Strong Python or C# skills
Experience working in Azure (storage, compute, identity, networking)
Ability to work independently in a Client-facing consulting role

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
Experience with Power Platform, Dataverse, and Power Automate
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Power BI
Experience with LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for AI in regulated industries
Consulting experience across multiple Clients or industries
Relevant certifications such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, Copilot Studio or Power Platform certifications, or Fabric (DP-600, DP-700)

What Success Looks Like In This Role

AI solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed

Your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff

jobs.title: Clinical Data Analyst | MS Graduates – 2026 | F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT
jobs.description:
Clinical Data Analyst | MS Graduates – 2026 | F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT Location:
Chicago, IL
Job Type:
Full-Time | Contract | Contract-to-Hire
Position Overview We are supporting opportunities for 2026 Master’s graduates interested in Clinical Data Analytics. This role focuses on analyzing clinical and healthcare data to support research, improve data quality, and generate insights for healthcare and clinical teams.
Key Responsibilities Collect, clean, validate, and analyze clinical datasets.
Use SQL and Excel to organize and interpret data.
Develop reports and dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
Identify trends, inconsistencies, and patterns in clinical data.
Collaborate with research, healthcare, and data teams.
Maintain data accuracy and follow applicable data privacy requirements.

Qualifications Master’s degree (MS) in Clinical Research, Health Informatics, Healthcare Analytics, Data Analytics, Biostatistics, or a related field.
Graduated in 2026 or expected to graduate in 2026.
Familiarity with SQL, Excel, Python, Power BI, or Tableau.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of clinical research data or EHR/EMR systems is a plus.

Work Authorization Candidates with F-1 OPT or STEM OPT work authorization may be considered, subject to individual eligibility and employer requirements.
Important Note Hidani Tech does not directly hire for these positions. We help candidates explore relevant opportunities and navigate the hiring process. Final hiring decisions are made by the respective employers. Opportunities are subject to availability and employer requirements.
